clips.title: The story
paras: Following a deadly centaur ambush on a merchant caravan in Thousand Needles, the goblin tinkerer Wizlo Bearingshiner was left as the sole survivor. Desperate to reclaim his prized invention, he hires adventurers to breach the wreckage, unlock an iron cage, and wrest the gizmo from the neck of a fearsome caged predator.

Caravans venturing beneath the towering sandstone spires of Thousand Needles run a perilous gauntlet. Hostile centaur prowl the canyon floor, fiercely guarding their territory and raiding any travelers bold enough to pass through. When one such trade caravan was overrun just north of Whitereach Post, the centaur slaughtered the travelers and plundered the wagons, leaving only the goblin Wizlo Bearingshiner to limp back to safety.

In the chaos of the raid, the centaur looted nearly every valuable scrap, but they gave one ruined wagon a wide berth. Bound inside a sturdy transport cage was a ferocious, enraged panther with Wizlo's prized hypercapacitor gizmo fastened directly around its neck. Daunted by the predator's snarling fury, the centaur abandoned the cage intact, forcing Wizlo to entrust its key to brave mercenaries capable of slaying the beast and reclaiming his gadget.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I am the only survivor from our caravan attack by the centaur! A rare yet mighty panther is guarding my best gizmo, which is around his neck. Hah! Even the centaur tremble in the presence of this ferocious beast!
Here is the key to the cage. They took everything there, but left him alone. Slay this beast and bring back my hypercapacitor, and I shall reward you.
The wrecked caravan is just north of here.

clips.title: Completion
paras: My hypercapacitor! This will keep me busy for a while until I can figure out what it does...
